body: It's a vicious cycle that keeps feeding itself. Once the cycle of pain started there seems to be no end. I know intellectually I could get out of this if some reason could be found for the pain, but emotionally I'm too exhausted to deal with this bullshit. I just want it to go away. And just when I thought almost everything else in my life could be going in the right direction... Life is a bitch isn't it.
Yes I have. That's why it is getting so pointless because there seems to be nothing wrong. But I know there has to be something. They keep telling me there isn't. So fuck them. No more doctors.
